title: Scripting: JavaScript in Workflows and Recipes | Orchard Core
description:
Recipes, workflows and layer rules can run JavaScript, but it is not obvious where scripts are evaluated, which methods they can call, or how to add your own.

The Scripting module evaluates a script by its prefix and gives it the methods that modules register, plus the methods scoped to a recipe or a workflow. This video shows where scripts run, how to add a method, how to evaluate a script from C#, and how to limit what a script can do.

In this video:
• How a script runs: prefixes, engines and where scripts are evaluated
• Scripts in a recipe: square brackets, variables and recipe methods
• Scripts in a workflow: the Script Task and the JavaScript syntax
• Methods a script can call: registered methods and scoped methods
• Add your own method: a global method provider
• Evaluate a script from C#: the scripting manager and scoped methods
• Limits and errors: what a script may do, and what happens when it fails
